semantic_contract: load tpd_cdev and log tpd: enter
call alloc_workqueue with format %s, flags 393226, max_active 1 and name tpd_wq
store the returned workqueue at tpd_cdev + 0x4b0
return -ENOMEM and log the failure on allocation failure
call tpd_report_work_init and destroy a zeroed workqueue slot on its failure path
initialize the probe delayed work at offsets 0x8d0 through 0x8f0
initialize the zlog delayed work at offsets 0xa50 through 0xa70
initialize the ghost-check delayed work at offsets 0x938 through 0x958
call tpd_resume_work_init and return zero on success
